# Project Structure

## Generated files

After `dart run react_tool:react build`, the following files are generated:

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `build/react/client.js` | Compiled client JavaScript bundle |
| `build/react/browser.entry.mjs` | Browser entry module |
| `build/react/ssr.entry.mjs` | SSR entry module (if SSR is configured) |
| `build/react/ssr_runtime.mjs` | SSR runtime (HTTP server + render) |
| `build/react/server` | Compiled Dart server binary (if server is configured) |
| `build/react/bundle_manifest.json` | Bundle manifest with entry points and sizes |
| `build/react/foreign/` | Bundled foreign component shims |
| `lib/*.react.dart` | Generated component bindings |
| `lib/*.react.g.dart` | Generated codegen output |
| `lib/server_actions.g.dart` | Generated server action registry |
| `lib/ssr_registry.g.dart` | Generated SSR component registry |

## react.yaml

The `react.yaml` file configures the project:

```yaml
client:
  entrypoint: web/client.dart
ssr:
  entrypoint: lib/ssr.dart
server:
  entrypoint: bin/server.dart
styles:
  entrypoints:
    - web/styles.scss
```

- `client.entrypoint` — Required. The client bootstrap file.
- `ssr.entrypoint` — Optional. The SSR entrypoint. If omitted, SSR is disabled.
- `server.entrypoint` — Optional. The server entrypoint. If omitted, no server binary is built.
- `styles.entrypoints` — Sass/SCSS files to compile into CSS.

## react_tool CLI

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `react init <name>` | Scaffold a new project |
| `react build` | Build client, SSR, and server bundles |
| `react serve` | Build and serve the project |
| `react clean` | Remove build artifacts |
| `react doctor` | Inspect project configuration |
| `react js` | Generate JavaScript bindings |
| `react ts` | Generate TypeScript bindings |
